passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
David was the king of Israel.
David trusted God.
David often prayed to God.
David praised God in his songs.

passages.text: To You, O LORD, I call; be not deaf to me, O my Rock. For if You remain silent, I will be like those descending to the Pit.
passages.sermon:
David speaks this prayer.
David calls out to the LORD.
David says, "You are my Rock."
David asks the LORD to hear him.
David asks the LORD not to be silent toward him.
David says, "If You stay silent, I will be like those who go down to the Pit."
David fears being counted among the dead if God does not answer.
passages.original: לְדָוִ֡ד אֵ֘לֶ֤יךָ יְהוָ֨ה׀ אֶקְרָ֗א צוּרִי֮ אַֽל־ תֶּחֱרַ֪שׁ מִ֫מֶּ֥נִּי פֶּן־ תֶּֽחֱשֶׁ֥ה מִמֶּ֑נִּי וְ֝נִמְשַׁ֗לְתִּי עִם־ י֥וֹרְדֵי בֽוֹר׃

passages.text: Hear my cry for mercy when I call to You for help, when I lift up my hands toward Your holy sanctuary.
passages.sermon:
David speaks to the LORD.
David asks God to listen to him.
David cries out for mercy.
David calls to God for help.
David lifts his hands toward God's holy sanctuary.
passages.original: שְׁמַ֤ע ק֣וֹל תַּ֭חֲנוּנַי בְּשַׁוְּעִ֣י אֵלֶ֑יךָ בְּנָשְׂאִ֥י יָ֝דַ֗י אֶל־ דְּבִ֥יר קָדְשֶֽׁךָ׃

passages.text: Do not drag me away with the wicked, and with the workers of iniquity, who speak peace to their neighbors while malice is in their hearts.
passages.sermon:
David speaks to the LORD.
David asks God for help.
David says, “Do not drag me away with wicked people.”
Wicked people do evil things.
Wicked people speak words of peace to their neighbors.
Wicked people hide evil in their hearts.
David does not want to be counted with them.
passages.original: אַל־ תִּמְשְׁכֵ֣נִי עִם־ רְשָׁעִים֮ וְעִם־ פֹּ֪עֲלֵ֫י אָ֥וֶן דֹּבְרֵ֣י שָׁ֭לוֹם עִם־ רֵֽעֵיהֶ֑ם וְ֝רָעָ֗ה בִּלְבָבָֽם׃

passages.text: Repay them according to their deeds and for their works of evil. Repay them for what their hands have done; bring back on them what they deserve.
passages.sermon:
God sees the actions of the wicked.
God knows the evil things they do.
God, give them what their actions deserve.
Give them what their evil deeds deserve.
Repay them for what their hands have done.
Give them the reward they have earned.
Give them what they truly deserve.
passages.original: תֶּן־ לָהֶ֣ם כְּפָעֳלָם֮ וּכְרֹ֪עַ מַֽעַלְלֵ֫יהֶ֥ם כְּמַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יְ֭דֵיהֶם תֵּ֣ן לָהֶ֑ם הָשֵׁ֖ב גְּמוּלָ֣ם לָהֶֽם׃

passages.text: Since they show no regard for the works of the LORD or what His hands have done, He will tear them down and never rebuild them.
passages.sermon:
The LORD acts with power and purpose.
Some people do not understand the works of the LORD.
They do not pay attention to what the LORD has done.
The LORD will tear these people down.
He will not build them up again.
passages.original: כִּ֤י לֹ֤א יָבִ֡ינוּ אֶל־ פְּעֻלֹּ֣ת יְ֭הוָה וְאֶל־ מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יָדָ֑יו יֶ֝הֶרְסֵ֗ם וְלֹ֣א יִבְנֵֽם׃

passages.text: Blessed be the LORD, for He has heard my cry for mercy.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD listens to prayer.
I called out for mercy.
The LORD heard my cry.
I praise the LORD.
passages.original: בָּר֥וּךְ יְהוָ֑ה כִּי־ שָׁ֝מַע ק֣וֹל תַּחֲנוּנָֽי׃

passages.text: The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusts in Him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart rejoices, and I give thanks to Him with my song.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
The LORD is my strength.
The LORD is my shield.
My heart trusts in the LORD.
The LORD helps me.
My heart rejoices.
I give thanks to the LORD with my song.
passages.original: יְהוָ֤ה׀ עֻזִּ֥י וּמָגִנִּי֮ בּ֤וֹ בָטַ֥ח לִבִּ֗י וְֽנֶ֫עֱזָ֥רְתִּי וַיַּעֲלֹ֥ז לִבִּ֑י וּֽמִשִּׁירִ֥י אֲהוֹדֶֽנּוּ׃

passages.text: The LORD is the strength of His people, a stronghold of salvation for His anointed.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is strong.
He gives strength to His people.
He protects His people.
He saves His anointed one.
He is a safe place for His anointed.
He is a stronghold of salvation.
passages.original: יְהוָ֥ה עֹֽז־ לָ֑מוֹ וּמָ֘ע֤וֹז יְשׁוּע֖וֹת מְשִׁיח֣וֹ הֽוּא׃

passages.text: Save Your people and bless Your inheritance; shepherd them and carry them forever.
passages.sermon:
God, save Your people.
God, bless Your inheritance.
God, shepherd Your people.
God, carry them forever.
passages.original: הוֹשִׁ֤יעָה׀ אֶת־ עַמֶּ֗ךָ וּבָרֵ֥ךְ אֶת־ נַחֲלָתֶ֑ךָ וּֽרְעֵ֥ם וְ֝נַשְּׂאֵ֗ם עַד־ הָעוֹלָֽם׃
